faqs.a:
Renunciation and abandonment are not voluntary and complete so as to be a defense
               to prosecution under
sections 62-74
,
62-75
, or
62-76
, if they are motivated in whole or in part by:
(1)
A belief that a circumstance exists which increases the probability of detection or
                  apprehension of the defendant or another or which makes more difficult the consummation
                  of the crime; or
(2)
A decision to postpone the crime until another time or to substitute another victim
                  or another but similar objective.
(
Ord. No. 4076, § 5, 7-16-2007
)
